discription: A rich, detuned saw wave with an ADSR envelope, suitable for pads or leads.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.005, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0, curve=-4; var sig, env; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: curve), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = (Saw.ar(freq) + Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune))) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
